metaDescription: Bracco Italiano vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Bracco Italiano boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Colostrum fade is the clock behind this Bracco Italiano table, and doses at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks exist to immunize the puppy while exposure (parks, foster homes, boarding intros) is rising.
Boarding desks ask for finished Bracco Italiano dates, not intentions, so a Bracco Italiano with only the first DA2PP / DHPP dose is still incomplete for most facilities.
Hip dysplasia shows up often enough in Bracco Italianos that vaccine day is also screening day — keep both on the same visit when possible.
Store the rabies label with the Bracco Italiano profile immediately; lost paperwork is the most common reason Bracco Italiano travel and kennel check-ins stall.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Bracco Italiano shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hip dysplasia worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Bracco Italiano make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Bracco Italiano antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Bracco Italiano dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this large dog.
Reset the Bracco Italiano reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Bracco Italiano core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Bracco Italiano misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Bracco Italiano health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Bracco Italiano adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
